name: Coach wa Itsudemo Ko~chi Coach!
original_name: コーチはいつでもこ～ちコチッ!
source:
I am a swimming coach, working on teaching my students for the coming national convention. They have to do anything I say!! Well, what I gonna do today.....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ016617.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我是一名游泳教练，正在为即将到来的全国代表大会教我的学生。他们必须按我说的做！嗯，今天我要做什么……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ016617.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
